name: uistyle_felt
ref_note: Image 1 is a mock-up of a mobile game battle screen. This is a UI RESTYLE task: keep the layout, the colours' overall warm cream / wood / coral / teal palette, every element's position and size, the cats, the floor background, the icons, numbers and Korean text; change ONLY how the user-interface pieces are drawn (buttons, panels, chips, bars, the tooltip).
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: mobile game UI style mockup, portrait 9:16
Primary request: redraw the UI pieces of image 1 in this style: FELT AND STITCH: every button is a matte felt patch (flat colour, soft fabric texture, no gloss, no gradient) with a cream dashed stitch line running just inside its edge and a soft drop shadow instead of a hard 3D lip; panels are linen cards with stitched borders; counters are small fabric labels; the main Summon button is a big coral felt patch with cream stitches; icon buttons look like round sewing buttons; text is dark brown without outlines.
Constraints: same composition as image 1, crisp readable Korean text exactly as in image 1, no glossy plastic buttons, no thick dark game-style outlines around UI, no purple, no new elements, no watermark.
